## 1. Summary

本计划实现[修订稿](../spec/2026-09-22-17-16-tianshu-java-cqe-standards-amendment.md)及未被替换的[原Spec](../spec/2026-09-21-17-18-tianshu-prompt-skill-management.md)，依赖顺序为组件守卫与DDL能力→共享租户/AI合同→单版DDL→原11表MP迁移→5张AI表与业务→REST/RPC/Web→Outbox通知→受控导入与验收，共24步。Review状态供用户审核；每步验证和一次语义提交属于后续执行合同，本轮不执行。
目标是同租户内按biz/namespace/env/app隔离Prompt/Skill、可编辑纯文本树、不可变版本和跨namespace复制发布；starter两个开关默认关闭。关键放行证据为白名单负例、真实PG/SS键/事务和Outbox验证、旧wire金样本、Redis租户隔离、Web交互及迁移逐表对账。

## 4. Implementation Strategy and Dependency Order

### 4.1 Ordered strategy

先稳定可复用组件与跨模块类型，再以Tianshu V001 DDL建立全表和可信tenant上下文；后续已应用schema变化只加manifest有序前向版本，不改已提交的旧SQL；保留Spec既定STRATEGY风格，扩展SINGLE逻辑表的schema配置（默认public），使Outbox表/schema/history沿用组件既有独立MP manifest并路由到egon_outbox；normal bootstrap只读验证，Tianshu public.ddl_history经同一物理PRIMARY做schema-scoped只读校验。旧表Repository按相互依赖的五表、两表、四表分组改，Step 11统一删除旧JPA映射。Step 6将Admin Redis和发布锁/waiter改为必须使用可信tenant；三个既有后台任务在Step 10获得tenant-bearing BO后，按已登记tenant逐个通过DdcTenantContextExecutor运行并验证。Step 8–10可在隔离测试中分别RED/GREEN，但Admin后台启动/调度门禁只在Step 11、18、19及最终联调后开启。AI版本/推广必须在持久化和草稿之后；Web先API，再树编辑、版本/推广。Outbox改造保留原Redis ACK与reconcile，发布结果和消息交付结果分开。
原天枢是传统三层模块，不属于native Light/Web/Service生成器档案；用户也明确本次豁免在制后端code generator。DDL与每个PO/Mapper/XML手工按批准Spec建，现有protoc/MapStruct编译继续。

### 4.2 Test-first strategy

所有行为Step先新增或修改聚焦契约测试：缺少目标类型/Mapper/约束时RED，之后完成最小实现再GREEN。Step 3仅POM与Lombok处理器，编译缺失依赖即RED，属无业务行为的证据化例外。Step 24的真实PG/Redis测试编写先于受控环境执行；无该环境时维持“未验证”，不以mock冒充。

### 4.4 Commit boundaries

用户AGENTS规则是每个逻辑任务至多一个提交；执行时24个Step是审查/验证边界，不强制产生24次提交。若一次获准执行覆盖多个Step，最终以一次路径限定提交收束该逻辑任务；未获实施批准时不提交。对同一文件的多步编辑按Step顺序并在变更清单标记各次语义。

## 6. Prerequisites, Constraints, and Plan Clarifications

### 6.1 Repository and worktree baseline

- 基线`main@b31357a0a`。用户会话AGENTS约束适用；无仓库内额外适用AGENTS。执行前复核实际HEAD与逐文件hash。
- 当前其他任务修改的玉衡Spec/Plan、天权Spec、components/pom.xml及在制generator目录均不在本计划写范围；任何并发变化先以路径比对，不覆盖。
- 原V1–V9 Flyway脚本只保留归档字节，不修改、不重放到新MP目标。新目标仅一版MP DDL；日志SQL journal因本次明确不运行code generator而不产生。

### 6.2 Build, test, and environment prerequisites

| Concern | Exact command/source | Required state | Validation boundary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Maven组件/模块 | `mvn -q -Dtest=DdcTenantIsolationTest -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false test`（以Step 5为例；其余Step给定具体选择器） | JDK21、本地依赖可解析；缺环境不推断运行通过 | 编译/单测 |
| Web | `cd egon-cola-xingyuan/egon-cola-tianshu/egon-cola-tianshu-admin-web && npm test -- --run`、`npm run typecheck`、`npm run build` | 已安装锁定依赖；不启动Vite | 静态/单测 |
| 真实PG/Redis | 后续显式`tianshu-ai-persistence-it`隔离环境，用户控制连接信息 | 空目标PG＋隔离Redis/ACL；禁自动Docker与服务启动 | 仅受控IT |
| SQL及manifest | `sha256sum`或JDK Digest与MP manifest解析 | 最终SQL字节hash匹配；历史前缀不可变 | 静态＋真实目标重入 |

### 6.3 Immutable constraints and approved decisions

Outbox组件引入和MP受控扩展已在本会话获批；批准时同一Outbox组件版本为5.4.0，当前父POM独立升级至5.4.1，计划对齐当前仓库；MapStruct/MP来自用户确认原Spec。新依赖需另行批准；Rabbit/Kafka、模板引擎和在制generator均不加入。所有业务命令从可信tenant获取上下文，REST body/header不能越权选租户。组件恢复生产白名单为空；Skill节点软删。

### 6.4 Plan Clarifications

2026-09-27执行复核补齐Step 5的现有运行组装路径：DdcRpcSecurityConfiguration把租户注册表和finally恢复的上下文执行器接入服务端拦截器；DdcRpcAutoConfiguration把DdcTenantProperties传入运行时客户端工厂。原Step 5只有组件工厂和ConfigData入口，实际RPC Bean仍不会携带tenant；Admin安全链也不会构造新filter，故无法达到本步已批准§9.5合同。同步纳入受HMAC v2、AI_READ映射、tenant资源身份与optional安全错误影响的既有测试，并把验证改为仓库根目录reactor命令，因为两个首要测试分别位于Admin与RPC adapter模块。补入的DdcConfigRpcProviderTest、DdcManagementRpcProviderTest、DdcRegistryRpcProviderTest只适配tenant-bearing Principal构造，不改原Provider业务断言。独立导入DdcRpcSecurityConfiguration的DdcAdminContextSmokeTest和DdcAdminSecurityPropertiesTest同步显式提供租户registry/executor fixture。未增加依赖、外部字段、授权规则或服务端功能；DdcRpcAutoConfiguration保留Step 17的后续AI端口语义。

2026-09-28执行复核闭合Step 6改为tenant-scoped Redis/waiter后的现有后台消费者：DdcLeaseExpiryScanner的关系查询和lease Redis操作、PublishStartupRecovery的任务读取/dispatch、PublishTimeoutScanner的任务读取/终态通知均由调度线程启动，不能读取请求线程MDC。它们依赖的DdcInstanceBO/DdcPublishTaskBO tenant字段在Step 10建成，且Step 10已声明上述三个生产文件与对应测试；因此Step 10须从已校验的DdcTenantAdminProperties绑定列表逐tenant复核DdcTenantRegistry状态，并使用既有DdcTenantContextExecutor以system actor隔离执行和finally恢复，不从业务表枚举tenant、不设默认tenant。逐tenant异常记录安全日志后继续其他tenant；DdcLeaseExpiryScanner在完成per-tenant config-lease扫描后只调用一次会自行按已知tenant隔离的registry expireKnown。Step 10定向验证加入三个后台合同测试；Admin完整启动/调度仍按§4.1延至Step 11及后续门禁。未新增文件、依赖或公开业务API。

2026-09-28执行复核对齐已批准Outbox依赖的当前MP schema owner：组件manifest `component-outbox/20260924_001`实际在`egon_outbox`创建消息表及独立history，schema metadata校验要求技术`tenant_id=0`、`deleted_at IS NULL`和MP审计/version列；原Step 7把组件消息表复制进Tianshu SQL会造成两个owner且字段不符。故Tianshu唯一新SQL只创建16业务表、public.ddl_history和egon_outbox schema；Outbox表/history仍由未修改的组件既有manifest管理。组件现有逻辑数据源factory会自动调用initializer，和本稿“普通启动只读验证”冲突；Step 7增加默认true、Tianshu false的`auto-initialize-ddl`兼容开关及单测，显式CLI按Tianshu SQL→组件manifest顺序初始化，normal bootstrap只准备readiness并由OutboxSchemaMetadataValidator只读核验。组件现有`migration-mode`仍保持enqueue/dispatch维护门禁语义。本修正只触及直接承载已批准Outbox契约的组件配置/initializer/测试/README及Tianshu DDL/CLI，无新依赖或Outbox消息API。

2026-09-28继续核对发现Strategy路由合同与Outbox技术schema：已接受Spec要求保持`STRATEGY`，而当前MP SINGLE策略硬编码public、Outbox要求`egon_outbox`。Step 7扩展Common MP的TableProperties增加可选schema（默认public，schema override只准SINGLE）、SINGLE实际节点/YAML输出和工厂拒绝非SINGLE静默忽略；Outbox initializer接受STRATEGY和NATIVE，但仍用TopologyValidator核对同一PRIMARY上的message/history SINGLE节点与LOCAL事务。Tianshu逻辑表名`ddl_history`只映射egon_outbox组件history；public.ddl_history由managed DDL和ready validator从同物理primary的public schema直接访问。默认TableProperties五参数构造器及现有public routes保持兼容。


2026-09-28用户批准按仓库路由合同修订Step 8表名：Persistence YML的`tables`键是ShardingSphere逻辑名（如`ddc_biz`），DDL中的`ddc_biz_t0`仅为实际物理DataNode。Common MP Guard在dynamic-table-name关闭时不去除`_t0`后缀，直接用Mapper SQL的tableName查route profile；因此Step 8五个PO的`@TableName`及Mapper SQL使用逻辑名，再由STRATEGY映射到物理`*_t0`，不得按早期伪代码直写物理表名。dynamic-table-name保持关闭，不改DDL或外部API；DdcMetadataRepositoryContractTest验证PO/XML逻辑名、Persistence YML逻辑表配置与实际物理target对应。

2026-09-28 Step 10 DDL 复核对照已确认原Spec §11.2.10：`ddc_instance` 必须有 `uk_instance_business(tenant_id, instance_id)`，而 Step 7 的 V001 SQL/manifest/readiness index-contract 少了该键；旧 JPA 映射也保证过 instanceId 唯一。保持 V001 和其SHA/history前缀不可变，Step 10 加 V002 前向 `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX`、将 manifest 扩展为 V001→V002，并让 DdcDatabaseReadyValidator 校验每个manifest脚本的资源checksum、完整history和该索引；DdcTianshuDdlContractTest先对缺失键断言RED再转GREEN。索引冲突必须令CLI初始化/业务readiness失败，不删除、合并或改写旧实例。Step 10 因此扩展4条文件路径及 DDL 合同测试，不加新依赖或运行环境。

2026-09-28 Step 11 执行复核发现 `DdcStringMapConverter` 在 Step 10 将 `DdcInstancePO.runtimeMetadata` 切至字段级 MP `DdcRuntimeMetadataTypeHandler` 后已无生产或测试调用方；该旧类仅实现 JPA `AttributeConverter`。为完成 REQ-011 的无 JPA 源码目标且不保留无用重复转换器，将 §5 变更清单和 Step 11 File 20 的动作由 MODIFY 更正为 DELETE。现有 MP `BaseTypeHandler<Map<String, String>>` 继续负责字段 JSON 序列化、反序列化和空值语义；不改变列类型、JSON内容、wire字段或迁移路径。

2026-09-29 Step 13 pre-edit contract audit: §9.1/§9.5 says Service outputs wire business DTOs and §13 assigns permissions/transactions to Service while named business reads/writes belong to Repositories. Step 12 currently creates resource/draft-node Repository interfaces with only findActiveById; direct Service-to-Mapper or concrete generic CRUD would violate that boundary. API-003 additionally requires a root FOR SHARE read before assembling detail plus live nodes, and Summary needs namespaceCode/currentVersionNo without N+1 queries. Step 13 therefore extends the two business Repository ports/implementations, adds Resource FOR SHARE SQL, and adds same-tenant namespace/current-version read projections on existing PO/BO using TableField(exist=false). Existing MapStruct Resource/DraftNode converters gain command/query/node DTO mappings; the BaseForwardConverter from ResourceBO to SummaryDTO moves from Step 16 to Step 13 so the Service response compiles and conforms. 2026-09-29 Step 13 transaction correction: API-003 requires SELECT FOR SHARE inside the READ COMMITTED detail-read transaction. The PostgreSQL JDBC driver maps Connection read-only mode to BEGIN READ ONLY for transactional connections; the read-only transaction mode is incompatible with row-locking reads. Therefore ddcAiReadTransactionTemplate must leave JDBC readOnly false while Service GET/page remain DML-free; both templates share the existing transactionManager and READ_COMMITTED isolation. This avoids a new transaction manager or runtime dependency and is covered by a template configuration test.
2026-09-29 Step 13 lifecycle retry correction: the immutable V001 resource/draft-node business-key indexes can collide when repeated soft deletes obtain the same PostgreSQL transaction timestamp. DELETE and draft replacement must let the failed transaction fully roll back, then retry the complete Service operation in a fresh LOCAL transaction up to three retries; every retry reloads/locks the root and rechecks expectedRevision. Exhaustion maps to HTTP 409/code 56316, with the row still live and no partial tree changes. Do not alter deleted_at precision, bypass the MP lifecycle guard, or retry in a transaction already marked rollback-only.

- Purpose: 为配置发布和服务注册Topic增加可信tenant外层，不改变既有业务payload字段。
- Symbols: `DdcTenantMessageDTO<T>`
- Repository evidence: 当前类型不存在；这是原Spec §15.2 明确规定的外层通知DTO，使用Starter共享model层。
- Dependencies and consumers: 前置 Step 5；本步先完成两个测试合同，再供配置/注册发布者、订阅者消费。
- Why now: 同租户键/Topic隔离与回调校验需要在线协议携带可验证tenant；只换Topic无法检测错租户envelope。
- Contract/signature changes: 普通class使用完整Lombok；字段为 `@NotNull @Positive Long tenantId` 和 `@NotNull @Valid T payload`；提供 `belongsToTenant(Long expectedTenantId)` 精确匹配；payload从 `toString` 排除。RTopic的 `DdcConfigChangeListener` 和 `DdcManagedRegistrySubscription` 在非代理边界先调用现有 `ValidationUtils.validate(envelope)`，再作精确tenant匹配。配置通知仍包裹原 `DdcPublishMessage`，注册通知仍包裹原 `DdcRegistryEvent`，旧payload字段不变。
- Input/output and state mapping: 发送端取已验证的Starter tenant；接收端仅与本地配置tenant比较。匹配后原样交付同一payload，不从envelope切换MDC/tenant，不修改ACK、revision或fencing字段。
- Error and edge behavior: Bean Validation constraint violation、空/非正tenant、空payload或tenant不等于订阅tenant均不得交给业务listener；listener记录安全告警并丢弃，不回退到旧裸消息、不把消息tenant当可信上下文。序列化验证沿用当前Redisson Topic codec，不添加多态Jackson默认类型或新codec依赖。
- Standards impact: MC-SCOPE-001, MC-TEST-001, MC-ARCH-001, MC-NAME-001, MC-VALID-001, MC-MODEL-001, MC-LOG-001；Rule 1, Rule 2, Rule 3, Rule 4, Rule 5, Rule 6, Rule 10, Rule 11。
- Literal rule enforcement: Rule 1, Rule 2, Rule 3, Rule 4, Rule 5, Rule 6, Rule 10, Rule 11；`DTO`语义后缀；tenant/payload注解约束并在消费边界显式匹配；class使用@Data/@NoArgsConstructor/@AllArgsConstructor/@Accessors(chain=true)/@Builder；payload不进入日志诊断；只使用现有Jackson/Redisson与JDK；本次不增加持久化和业务Event。
- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
var envelope = new DdcTenantMessageDTO<>(trustedTenantId, existingPayload);
if (envelope == null || envelope.getTenantId() == null
        || !envelope.belongsToTenant(configuredTenantId)
        || envelope.getPayload() == null) {
    log.warn("Discarding Tianshu topic message with an invalid tenant envelope");
    return;
}
listener.onMessage(envelope.getPayload());
```

- Verification contribution: `DdcTenantCallbackTest`验证包络字段/既有payload不变、匹配tenant通过、缺失或错tenant在callback前被拒绝并安全丢弃。
- After this file: DTO仅提供外层合同；生产/消费接线与同slot及本地状态隔离仍由后续本Step文件完成。

```java
@Test void autoInitializeDdlFalseSkipsRunnerAndPreparesReadiness() {
  storageConfigurationRunner().withPropertyValues(PREFIX + ".auto-initialize-ddl=false").run(context -> {
    var properties = context.getBean("outboxMpStorageProperties", OutboxMpStorageProperties.class);
    var ddlRunner = mock(EgonColaPostgreDdlRunner.class);
    stubRunnerWithManifestResults(ddlRunner);
    var initializer = initializerWithValidTopology(properties, strategyPropertiesWithOutboxSchema(), ddlRunner);
    initializer.initialize(physicalSources, strategyYamlLoader.load(strategyPropertiesWithOutboxSchema()));
    verifyNoInteractions(ddlRunner); // false bootstrap prepares metadata readiness without applying SQL.
    assertReadinessPreparedForOutboxSchemaMetadataValidator();
  });
}
@Test void strategyConfigUsesResolvedOutboxSingleSchemaRoute() {
  var sharding = strategyPropertiesWithOutboxSchema();
  var route = topologyValidator.validate(sharding, strategyYamlLoader.load(sharding));
  initializer(sharding, autoInitializeDdlFalse()).initialize(physical, route.yaml());
  assertThat(route.profiles()).containsOutboxMessageAndHistoryOnPrimary("egon_outbox");
}
```

```java
                              List<String> tableColumns, String rootKeyName,
```

#### File 10 — `CREATE egon-cola-components/egon-cola-component-common/egon-cola-component-common-mybatis-plus-sharding-jdbc-ext-spring-boot-starter/src/main/java/top/egon/cola/component/common/mybatis/sharding/algorithm/EgonColaStandardTenantIdShardingAlgorithm.java`

- Purpose: provide the one-level positive-tenant Standard algorithm used by `STANDARD_TENANT_ID` database and table strategies.
- Symbols: `EgonColaStandardTenantIdShardingAlgorithm.init`, precise `doSharding`, range `doSharding`
- Repository evidence: `EgonColaLongTenantShardingAlgorithm` calls the two-level profile parser, requires `_tN_bN` targets and slot/bucket properties; it cannot route the Standard strategy's `_tN` legacy profile.
- Dependencies and consumers: existing ShardingSphere `StandardShardingAlgorithm<Long>` API and `EgonColaStandardTenantIdShardingStrategy`; no new dependency.
- Why now: parseable YAML alone is insufficient if the referenced algorithm still requires unrelated two-level profile properties; Tianshu business tables use one-level `tenant_id` routing.
- Contract/signature changes: `init` requires a unique comma-separated `target-order` property; precise routing filters that declared order by current available candidates and selects by `Long.remainderUnsigned(tenantId,targetCount)`; reject invalid keys, missing candidates and range sharding.
- Input/output and state mapping: database/table Standard algorithms consume orders generated from `EgonColaRoutingProfileBO.actualNodes`, preserving `legacy-v1` target selection irrespective of the Collection iteration order supplied by ShardingSphere; Tianshu's 1×1 topology resolves to its single physical target.
- Error and edge behavior: null/zero/negative tenant fails with `SHARDING_KEY`; missing target-order fails with `STANDARD_TARGET_ORDER_REQUIRED`; blank/duplicate order entries fail with `STANDARD_TARGET_ORDER_INVALID`; an order with no current candidates fails with `SHARDING_TARGET_UNAVAILABLE`; range input fails with `TENANT_RANGE_FORBIDDEN`; no database or thread-local context is accessed.
- Standards impact: MC-SCOPE-001, MC-TEST-001, MC-ARCH-001, MC-NAME-001, MC-LOG-001, MC-UTIL-001, MC-PATTERN-001。
- Literal rule enforcement: Rule 1 uses the semantic algorithm role; Rule 4 follows existing algorithm `@Slf4j` convention; Rule 5 uses only JDK and ShardingSphere APIs; Rule 9 keeps route selection in the existing Strategy; Rule 11 stays in Common MP.
- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
@Slf4j
public final class EgonColaStandardTenantIdShardingAlgorithm implements StandardShardingAlgorithm<Long> {
    private volatile List<String> targetOrder = List.of();
    @Override public void init(Properties properties) {
        if (properties == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("STANDARD_TARGET_ORDER_REQUIRED");
        Set<String> unique = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        for (String candidate : required(properties, "target-order").split(",", -1)) {
            String target = candidate.trim();
            if (target.isBlank() || !unique.add(target)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("STANDARD_TARGET_ORDER_INVALID");
        }
        targetOrder = List.copyOf(unique);
    }
    @Override public String doSharding(Collection<String> available, PreciseShardingValue<Long> value) {
        requirePositiveTenant(value);
        if (available == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SHARDING_KEY");
        List<String> targets = targetOrder.stream().filter(available::contains).toList();
        if (targets.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("SHARDING_TARGET_UNAVAILABLE");
        return targets.get((int) Long.remainderUnsigned(value.getValue(), targets.size()));
    }
    @Override public Collection<String> doSharding(Collection<String> available, RangeShardingValue<Long> value) {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("TENANT_RANGE_FORBIDDEN");
    }
}
```

- Verification contribution: the Common MP test class directly invokes precise selection and range rejection; route configuration confirms Shardingsphere parses both Standard algorithm declarations.
- After this file: Standard algorithm instantiation no longer depends on two-level profile properties or `_tN_bN` naming.

```yaml
            ddc_ai_draft_node: { type: STANDARD_TENANT_ID }
            ddc_ai_version_node: { type: STANDARD_TENANT_ID }
```

- Error and edge behavior: 仅处理配置中enabled且经`DdcTenantRegistry.requireEnabledTenant`复核的tenant；每个tenant的异常记录tenantId与异常类后继续下一tenant，executor finally恢复外层MDC；不从关系表枚举租户、不默认tenant。

```java
for (DdcTenantBindingDTO configured : tenantProperties.getBindings()) {
  if (!configured.isEnabled()) continue;
  DdcTenantBindingDTO trusted = tenantRegistry.requireEnabledTenant(configured.getTenantId());
  DdcTenantContextDTO context = systemContext(trusted, "system:lease-expiry");
  try {
    configExpired += tenantContextExecutor.call(context, () -> scanConfigLeases(now));
  } catch (RuntimeException failure) {
    log.warn("Tianshu lease-expiry scan failed for tenantId={}, reason={}",
        trusted.getTenantId(), failure.getClass().getSimpleName());
  }
}
serviceExpired = registryRepository.expireKnown(now); // scopes each recorded tenant itself
```

```java
inside ddcAiCommandTransactionTemplate, read root without lock; PUBLISH-authorize to lock biz→namespace→env→app→binding and refresh cache; check tenant/requestId receipt before CAS; on a miss lock root, compare revision, prepare ContentStrategy, insert Version+all nodes+Publication and update pointer/lastVersionNo atomically.
rollback inserts receipt and updates pointer/revision only; getVersion reads exact VersionId nodes and verifies count/bytes/hash; AI emits no Event.
draft edit/publish/rollback increment `tianshu.ai.commands` with only operation/result tags and log requestId hash when present, never request body or tenant/root metric tags.
```

```java
                 nullableString(api, "DdcAiContentDTO", "promptText");
                 require(api, "DdcAiNodeDTO", "content"); nullableString(api, "DdcAiNodeDTO", "content"); };
}
// existing application.yml tianshu group, info and server configuration remain the source of truth.
```

- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
private void write(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response, int status, String code) {
  response.setStatus(status);
  if (request.getRequestURI().startsWith("/api/v1/tianshu/ai/")) response.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store");
  objectMapper.writeValue(response.getOutputStream(), Map.of("code", code, "message", code));

```

```java
@Override AiPromptResult getPrompt(@NotNull @Valid AiResourceQuery query) {
  requireDdcServicePrincipalAiRead();
  var published = service.getPublishedVersion(selector(query), DdcAiKindEnum.PROMPT);
  var prompt = DdcPromptResult.builder().resourceId(published.getVersion().getResourceId())
      .resourceKey(query.getResourceKey()).versionId(published.getVersion().getId())
      .versionNo(published.getVersion().getVersionNo()).contentSha256(published.getVersion().getContentSha256())
      .template(published.getContent().getPromptText()).build();
  return protoConverter.toProto(prompt);
}
@Override AiSkillResult getSkill(@NotNull @Valid AiResourceQuery query) {
  requireDdcServicePrincipalAiRead();
  var published = service.getPublishedVersion(selector(query), DdcAiKindEnum.SKILL);
  var skill = DdcSkillResult.builder().resourceId(published.getVersion().getResourceId())
      .resourceKey(query.getResourceKey()).versionId(published.getVersion().getId())
      .versionNo(published.getVersion().getVersionNo()).contentSha256(published.getVersion().getContentSha256())
      .files(published.getContent().getNodes()).build();
  return protoConverter.toProto(skill); // includes the complete text tree.
}
// Known AI CommonException codes become sanitized gRPC status/trailers; no management writes are exposed.
```

- Implementation pseudocode:

```java
@Mapper(componentModel="spring", implementationName="DdcRegistryRevisionEventConverterImpl")
interface DdcRegistryRevisionEventConverter
        extends BaseForwardConverter<DdcRegistryEvent, DdcRegistryRevisionEvent> {
  @Mapping(target="event", source=".")
  @Mapping(target="schemaVersion", constant="1")
  DdcRegistryRevisionEvent toTarget(DdcRegistryEvent source);
  default DdcRegistryRevisionEvent toTarget(DdcRegistryEvent source, Long trustedTenantId) {
    var target = toTarget(source);
    target.setTenantId(trustedTenantId);
    target.setEventId(DdcRegistryRevisionEvent.eventId(trustedTenantId, source));
    return target;
  }
}
```

- Verification contribution: DdcRegistryOutboxTest compares stable tenant/scope/revision identities and confirms the generated converter preserves the source event.

```typescript
it('keeps tenant, generation and cache when the dirty guard declines mismatch', async () => {
  registerUnsavedChangesGuard(async () => false);
  await expect(triggerTenantMismatch()).rejects.toMatchObject({status: 403});
  expect(sessionGeneration).toBe(previousGeneration);
  expect(queryClient.getQueryData(oldTenantKey)).toBe(previousData);
  expect(fetch).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1); // never replay the business request
});
```

#### File 4 — `MODIFY egon-cola-xingyuan/egon-cola-tianshu/egon-cola-tianshu-admin-web/src/auth/AuthContext.tsx`

- Purpose: 把login、logout、401授权清理和tenant mismatch重bootstrap汇合到同一会话变更守卫，dirty时先确认，再允许beginSession清理缓存。
- Symbols: `AuthContext`, `registerUnsavedChangesGuard`
- Repository evidence: Step20已提交，当前HEAD基线SHA256 `c44cfb95b323a8ea172a9ca04a46e48accbcd1bde68e7d3aff059ba9b674c746`；现有`beginSession`负责sessionGeneration、expected tenant、bootstrap及QueryClient clear。
- Dependencies and consumers: 前置Step20与File3测试；后续AiResourceEditorPage从现有useAuth context注册guard，AdminLayout继续调用logout。
- Why now: 只有AuthContext实际拥有beginSession及tenant mismatch处理；页面/布局各自守卫不能覆盖跨tab Cookie变化。
- Contract/signature changes: AuthContext增加`registerUnsavedChangesGuard(guard): unregister`；拒绝时login/logout/mismatch均不调用beginSession、不清cache、不重放业务请求；允许时保留现有转换语义。
- Input/output and state mapping: 多个组件注册的Promise<boolean> guard → 按序全部允许后执行一次session transition；任一拒绝则保持当前认证状态。
- Error and edge behavior: guard异常失败关闭并保留当前session；transition进行中拒绝并发第二个session change；旧generation异步响应仍按现有检查丢弃。
- Standards impact: MC-SCOPE-001, MC-TEST-001, MC-ARCH-001, MC-REUSE-001；Rule 6、Rule 7、Rule 11；无新的认证依据、wire字段、配置或backend API。
- Literal rule enforcement: Rule 6, Rule 7, Rule 11；复用React Context、现有sessionGeneration与QueryClient取消清空函数；JSON/profile/后端CQE边界不变。
- Implementation pseudocode:

```typescript
const runSessionTransition = async (transition: () => Promise<void>) => {
  if (transitionPending.current) return;
  transitionPending.current = true;
  try {
    for (const guard of guards.current) if (!(await guard())) return;
    await transition(); // only now call beginSession and clear tenant queries
  } finally {
    transitionPending.current = false;
  }
};
```

- Verification contribution: File3 cancellation/confirmation tests and existing switch/logout/mismatch cache-cancellation tests establish ordering and no-replay behavior.
- After this file: all session entry points share the tested boundary before the UI registers its current dirty buffer.

- Safety clarification: migration mode rejects identical normalized source/target/mapping paths and compares PostgreSQL `current_database()`, `inet_server_addr()` and `inet_server_port()` before import; overlap writes a failed report and stops. If target rollback fails, the connection remains outside auto-commit. Import reports include the checkpoint filename when present, per-table counts, and batch error table/public ID/hash; minimal connection-failure reports serialize an empty per-table map.

## 9. Migration, Compatibility, Rollout, and Rollback

Step 7在全新隔离PostgreSQL目标上用MP-SDJ runner创建初始`V20260922_001__tianshu_platform.sql`并在`repository-manifest.json`记录最终字节SHA-256；该版本建立16业务表、技术`ddl_history`及`egon_outbox` schema，Outbox表/history继续由组件独立manifest创建。Step 10只追加`V20260928_001__tianshu_instance_business_key.sql`，为`ddc_instance_t0`补齐原Spec要求的`UNIQUE(tenant_id, instance_id)`；已提交V001内容/hash不变，manifest和`DdcDatabaseReadyValidator`保留并验证完整有序前缀。目标物理表按1×1落`public.*_t0`。原V1–V9 Flyway历史和原库不可改。正常业务进程绝不自动建表或索引；显式CLI按manifest顺序初始化，存在重复实例键时索引创建失败并保留原数据。
源旧库冻结写入→签名确认tenant映射→逐表≤1000行只读源导入→比较count/public_id/字段hash/关联/版本/ACK→双租户与Redis v4切换演练→一次业务流量切换。导入记录同源hash重入可跳过，不同hash停止；未知tenant/孤儿/冲突停止并保留源库。切换前失败可放弃新目标；切换后不倒灌旧库，修复用新MP DDL版本及重放原ACK/reconcile。分布式多目标时逐目标只在一致checksum成功后放行；未知提交查history再重试，禁止改已应用SQL。
配置发布先同DataSource本地事务冻结并enqueue EVENT-101；worker重复调用原Redis原子分发/指针推进，成功入Outbox不等于原ACK。Registry Redis先变更，后在独立SQL事务enqueue EVENT-102；两者不原子，保留SDK周期reconcile。Outbox耗尽进入DEAD并告警/人工前向修复；Redis PubSub离线丢消息仍由原快照回补。新starter两个AI开关false；按租户登记、HMAC v2及Redis ACL配置就绪后显式启用。
组件MP新历史/恢复白名单默认空；Admin生产只为确有需要的AI历史select绑定精确statement ID，恢复白名单仍空。普通配置回滚只改legacy业务deleted/publishedVersion，不调用组件restore。重复同微秒软删除导致生命周期UK冲突时事务外最多重试3次，仍冲突返回409；已应用DDL的回退只用前向补丁版本。

## 12. Review and Acceptance

### 12.1 Original requirement fidelity

REQ-001～014与后续四维隔离、跨ns推广、默认关闭及全文本树均映射到Step 4/12–22；原REQ-010的“先审核Spec”已经由用户确认推进到本轮只写修订Spec与Plan。REQ-015～019分别对应建模、生成器豁免、Outbox、MP白名单和deleted_at键。

### 12.2 Spec consistency

修订稿§5覆盖矩阵明确替换旧record、biz.*、物理删除、partial-only UK、RTopic与旧DDL路径；其余原wire/表字段均沿用。§4.5审核未发现预取再转发API；无额外业务决策或Plan Clarification。

### 12.3 Repository executability

§5记录463个精确路径及基线hash；§7按依赖排序，标明每文件输入/映射/负例、测试命令、Step提交路径。执行前复核并发工作区与实际源码，当前只验证文档和路径。

### 12.4 Test and release completeness

Step 1/4–24聚焦RED/GREEN，Step 3编译RED/GREEN例外；§8区分单测、静态、受控PG/Redis与人工浏览器门禁；§9给出单版DDL、导入、切换、Outbox死信和前向修复。所有运行证据仍待实施阶段。
